trigger_condition: A traced nn.Module forward calls builtins.getattr on a Tensor attribute that does not exist and supplies a default value, e.g. getattr(a, 'nonexistent_attr', torch.Size([1,2])).
reason: The bug is reproducible by generating a model whose forward uses builtins.getattr with a default during torch.fx.symbolic_trace. The tracer drops the default argument, so executing the traced module raises AttributeError instead of returning the default, giving a clear oracle. This can be abstracted as an FX tracing semantic pattern for getattr defaults.
